releaseNotes:
v1.4.1: Comprehensive Reliability & Authentication Engine Fix.
• Extension Login Reliability & Handshake: Fixed undeclared title ReferenceError in portal.js; implemented adaptive 5s readiness handshake (PING_PORTAL_READY) replacing blind delay; handled closed tabs, slow script loads, and pre-authenticated state with bounded verification window.
• Telemetry Ingestion & Idempotency: Preserved client-generated stable event IDs through ingestion validator; added PostgreSQL-level duplicate resolution; added 5s debounce window ensuring user logout operations emit exactly one logical terminal outcome.
• Local/Cloud Data Reconciliation: Reconciled dashboard metrics across 10,230+ events with 100% parity to Supabase database queries; increased local store capacity to 50k events and pull limits to 25k; added bounded AbortSignal.timeout guards to prevent network hangs.
• macOS & Windows Updaters: Embedded POSIX 0755 execution permissions for macOS Gatekeeper compatibility and streamlined single-click unblockers.
updateInstructions: Double-click Update-Windows.bat (Windows) or Update-Mac.command (Mac), then reload on edge://extensions or chrome://extensions.

android.releaseNotes:
• Telemetry Idempotency & Queue Protection: Preserved client event IDs across network retries with backend deduplication.
• Multi-Device Login Stability: Hardened XML parsing and live mode 192 verification.
• External Wi-Fi Standby: Accurately detects non-campus networks and prevents false college connected states.
• 1-Tap Fast Logout: Parallelized session termination (<400ms) with zero hangs.
